bagPolicy.summary: EDC Las Vegas allows clear bags up to 12”x6”x12” and non-clear small clutch bags not exceeding 6”x9”. Hydration packs with specific compartments are also permitted.
allowed: NON-CLEAR small clutch bags not exceeding 6”x9”
NON-CLEAR hydration packs with no more than two main compartments and one smaller compartment
bagPolicy.note: Physician-prescribed medication bags are allowed with prescription and consultation with a safety officer.

parking.note: Premier Parking is available for purchase and offers easier access, while General Parking is free. ADA Parking is also available. All parking lots open at 3pm on Friday and 5pm on Saturday and Sunday.

rideshare.note: Use the Mid Brown Lot for rideshare pickup and drop-off. Drivers should take I-15 North to the East Tropical Parkway exit. Do not arrange pickup on Las Vegas Boulevard.

concessions.note: EDC Las Vegas offers an exclusive bottle service experience with private table service, a full bottle service menu, and access to private VIP restroom facilities. Guests can enjoy a welcome glass of champagne and golf cart transport to their table.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: ADA Parking has its own entry. Take I-15 North to Exit 58 at Apex, turn right on N Las Vegas Blvd, follow the signs for ADA Parking, and turn right into Entry 8.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Re-entry is not allowed, and there are no ins and outs during the day. Campers should check the Camp EDC entry rules for camping in-and-out policies.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: All international orders will be held at Will Call (view box office location and hours). If the passes are at Will Call, you must visit our off-site box office before arriving at the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Gate S is the only accessible entrance, for patrons with disabilities and up to one companion; all other entrances require walking down stairs. Ask for assistance before entering if you need it, and visit the Accessibility Services Hub, to the right after Gate S, right away.
